title: Academic Artificial Intelligence Degree Requirements
content:
Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence - Degree Requirements
Morgan State University Department of Computer Science

---

OFFICIAL PROGRAM CONTEXT

Morgan State University launched the Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence for Fall 2026. The university news release says the program was approved by Morgan State University's Board of Regents and the Maryland Higher Education Commission and represents a reimagining of the former Bachelor of Science in Cloud Computing.

CS Navigator should treat Artificial Intelligence, B.S. as its own degree profile when a student's DegreeWorks says Artificial Intelligence. It should not silently use the Computer Science B.S. curriculum for an AI major. Cloud Computing should remain available for legacy or teach-out students whose DegreeWorks/catalog year still shows Cloud Computing.

Sources:
- Morgan news release: https://www.morgan.edu/news/morgan-launches-artificial-intelligence-degree
- Department page: https://www.morgan.edu/computer-science/degrees-and-programs/bs_artificial-intelligence
- Catalog program page: https://catalog.morgan.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=28&poid=6725&returnto=2057

---

DEGREE OVERVIEW

A minimum of 120 credit hours are required to graduate with a B.S. in Artificial Intelligence.

Credit Distribution:
- General Education and University Requirements: 44 credits
- Supporting Courses: 14 credits
- Required Courses for the AI Major: 62 credits
- Total Credits: 120

ADVISING SAFETY NOTES

Use the student's real DegreeWorks degree program and catalog year first. If DegreeWorks says Artificial Intelligence, use the AI degree profile. If DegreeWorks says Computer Science, use Computer Science. If DegreeWorks says Cloud Computing, use the legacy Cloud Computing profile and advise the student to confirm teach-out requirements with an advisor.

A What-If audit can help compare a student against the AI major, but it may omit prior completed courses. Do not treat a partial What-If audit as a complete official transcript unless the completed and in-progress courses are present.

For live seats, CS Navigator's default Banner refresh includes COSC, CLCO, MATH, MGBU, BIOI, and GenEd subjects. Seat availability still depends on whether Banner has released the term and whether the admin refreshed that term recently.
